SELECT
    toYear(fs.DateKey) AS Year,
    toQuarter(fs.DateKey) AS Quarter,
    sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS ActualSales,
    sum(fsq.SalesAmountQuota) AS QuotaSales,
    round(sum(fs.SalesAmount) - sum(fsq.SalesAmountQuota), 2) AS Variance,
    round(
        (sum(fs.SalesAmount) - sum(fsq.SalesAmountQuota)) / nullIf(sum(fsq.SalesAmountQuota), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS VariancePct
FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
FULL OUTER JOIN retail.FactSalesQuota AS fsq
    ON fs.StoreKey = fsq.StoreKey
    AND fs.ProductKey = fsq.ProductKey
    AND fs.channelKey = fsq.ChannelKey
    AND toStartOfQuarter(fs.DateKey) = toStartOfQuarter(fsq.DateKey)
WHERE
    toYear(coalesce(fs.DateKey, fsq.DateKey)) = 2009
    AND toQuarter(coalesce(fs.DateKey, fsq.DateKey)) = 4
GROUP BY Year, Quarter
